messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: SERVICE=cache-redis, SEVERITY=critical, INCIDENT=PD12345. Page routed to team=eng-oncall.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: page fired to alex (oncall) — incident PD12345 (unacknowledged)

alex: Ack'ing oncall. I'm looking. Can someone paste current client error rate and p95 latency?

sam: seeing 502/503 spikes from frontend to backend around same time. Autoscale didn't kick yet. Quick check: redis maxclients reached on a subset of nodes.

maria: DB note: connection_queue is climbing on writer pg-master, lots of wait_for_lock and idle_in_transaction. Suspect upstream surge and some long-running queries from batch job. Also seeing elevated wait_event 'ClientRead' which suggests app-side backpressure.

alex: good context. TL;DR: redis nodes reporting 'maxclients' errors -> clients get connection errors -> app retries cascade -> pgbouncer/pg connections pile up -> pg queueing -> elevated latencies. Need short mitigation steps: 1) stop noncritical background jobs 2) bump redis maxclients temporarily on affected nodes 3) increase pgbouncer pool and restart gracefully 4) route traffic to healthy cache replicas 5) notify customers.

lia: prepping customer impact blurb. Draft: "We're investigating intermittent API errors affecting some requests. Our engineering team is actively mitigating; we'll post updates every 10 minutes." Approve?

jordan: yes, send now. Add note about "retries may be causing additional load".

alex: sending notification. lia, send now and paste link.

lia: Posted: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/PD12345 - short note up.

sam: infra actions: scaling group for cache did an emergency scale but one AZ's ASG hit instance quota. Manually launched a warm instance in that AZ and attached to cache pool. Also flagged heterogeneous eviction due to client overload.

alex: maria, can you run quick psql and pgbouncer checks and share output? I'm going to rotate a worker pool to reduce steady clients.

maria: psql snapshot:\n```\n-- pg_stat_activity sample\n datid | usename | state      | wait_event_type | wait_event    | query_start         | query \n-------+--------+-----------+-----------------+---------------+---------------------+-----------------\n  16384| svc_app| active    | Client          | ClientRead    | 2026-03-14 10:12:03 | SELECT ...      \n  16385| svc_app| idle_in_tx| Lock            | transactionid | 2026-03-14 09:58:12 | BEGIN; ...      \n```\npgbouncer: current_clients=2300, max_client_conn=4096, pool_mode=transaction, database svc_app: pools_active=480, waiting=120.

redis on node cache-03: `redis-cli info clients` shows connected_clients=1024, maxclients=1024, 'rejected_conn' counters incrementing.

alex: ok. Plan enacted: 1) temporarily bump maxclients to 2048 on cache-03 (maria/sam), 2) add firewall rule to limit known noisy IPs ingress for 10m (sam), 3) drain noncritical job workers (alex) 4) pgbouncer increase pool_size for svc_app from 500->800 and reload (maria). Do each and report back.

sam: bumping redis config now on cache-03: editing /etc/redis/redis.conf -> maxclients 2048 and `systemctl reload redis`. Watch for OOM. I also pre-warmed a sibling node to take some traffic.

maria: updating pgbouncer config and doing `pgbouncer -R` to reload pools now. Also killed one runaway batch query (ID 16385) after confirming safe to terminate.

alex: draining low-priority workers now: `kubectl scale deployment batch-jobs --replicas=0 --namespace=processing` — giving them 30s to gracefully stop.

sam: applied temporary firewall rate-limit on frontend LB for pattern /bulk/ : limit 20r/s.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: PD12345 acknowledged by alex at 2026-03-14T10:16:12Z

lia: customer update posted (update 2): "Mitigations underway. We've taken steps to reduce load and are bringing affected cache nodes back to healthy state. We will post next update in 10 minutes."

maria: after changes: redis cache-03 connected_clients=750, rejected_conn stopped incrementing. pgbouncer waiting reduced to 20. DB queueing decreased — 95th latency down from 2.2s -> 430ms.

alex: Nice. Monitoring for 10m. Sam please keep autoscale alerts audible; if any cache node drops under N healthy, escalate to oncall-senior.

sam: copied. Also created temporary route to bypass cache-03 if it misbehaves: HAProxy set backend weight 0 for cache-03.

jordan: ops/security note: bumping maxclients is OK temporary, but file descriptor pressure might grow. Let's schedule a follow-up to tune client pools.

alex: agreed. Post-incident: recommend: 1) add intelligent retry/backoff on client side 2) autoscale quota review 3) add health-based routing for cache 4) limit long-running DB tx from batch pipeline. I'll open a follow-up ticket.

lia: prepping customer RCA note for affected customers.

alex: handing off to sam for night coverage in 20m. Sam, I'm leaving summary and playbook in thread.

sam: taking handoff. Summary: PD12345 — cache maxclients hit -> rejected connections -> cascade to DB; mitigations applied: temp maxclients bump, prewarmed node attached, pgbouncer reload, drain batch jobs, firewall rate-limit. Monitoring looks stable. If errors spike again, escalate to @maria and @jordan.

incident-bot: PD12345 status: acknowledged -> resolved? not yet. Waiting 15m quiet window.

lia: final update posted to status page: "Errors subsiding; mitigation deployed. We'll update with RCA when available."

sam: marking the thread for postmortem and adding tags: cache, db, paging, pd, mitigation.

alex: thanks team. Leaving channel. :wave:

sam: copy. I'll close when quiet window passes and then move to postmortem.

jordan: FYI created follow-up ticket TKT-4321 for config & retry improvements.

lia: will coordinate customer-facing emails once RCA draft is ready.

incident-bot: PD12345: last activity at 2026-03-14T10:48:30Z
